parsed.explanation: Strong traveller-facing positives: no criminalisation of gender identity, constitutional and statutory equality protection with a demonstrably operating Equality Court (Nov 2025 ruling compelling trans-inmate care and clothing), a 2024 hate-crime/hate-speech regime covering gender identity, available legal gender recognition, and documented public acceptance signals. Negatives are real but partial: a March 2026 subregional overview documents disproportionate violence against trans/gender-nonconforming people in townships; a Dec 2024 tavern assault with arrest (positive state response); documented police mockery and service denial when ID is shown; facility access argued to be unequal in practice but without a ruling establishing a state-imposed birth-sex ban; dated impunity allegations (2010-13). The raw murder count has no denominator and cannot be used. Border treatment is unresolved — an open question, not an exposure. Net: functioning protections with meaningful street-level violence and institutional gaps.
